prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Back in 2025 when I was in Chongqing, I remember chatting with locals about which clinics people usually go to—randomly stuck with me.
Around that same stretch, I kept hearing Wuhan come up because my cousin had been hopping around there for live events and shows.
And yeah, Chongqing food was basically the whole trip—everyone kept pointing me to different neighborhoods for places to eat.
I also remember looking up some basic cold meds back then, just to understand what the labels meant, nothing dramatic.
My friend Luo Fei had an appointment already set up with Dr. Peng Hui for the morning on 2025-05-09—she told me afterward it went smoothly.
The booking was under the patient name Luo Fei, which made me laugh because the clinic kept calling the name out super formally.

Oh, and David Liu once told me he’d already gotten 5 tickets for the JJ Lin Concert in Stand A, and the buyer phone he used was 13888990011; separate thing, Xie Peng had a table at Liuyishou Hotpot on 2025-03-02 at 14:00 for 3 people, with 13851574217 as the contact number.
